subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella stay open until the remaining Anthropic signed-thinking replay prevention path lands, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the sole canonical tracker now?
rationale: The recovery-carrier fixes are on main, but the prevention work changes Anthropic replay semantics and overlaps several active issue and PR slices.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Promote the narrower tracker
options.body: Close this issue only after posting a clear handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and its candidate PR.

options.title: Wait for prevention merge
options.body: Keep the issue open now and close it as implemented only after the prevention PR merges with validation and release provenance.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate from recent Anthropic thinking work and the issue discussion around the landed recovery half.
